INSERT INTO characters (starter_key, name, avatar_path, tagline, personality,
                    scenario, greeting, example_dialogue, voice_anchor, appearance_tags,
                    default_tone, default_reply_style, age, created_at)
             VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
             RETURNING id AS "id!"
